title: Match Ergonomics and References
goal: Match on references without moving ownership of non-Copy fields.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 1 Afternoon: Match Ergonomics

sections.text: Matching on a value by value moves its non-`Copy` fields out of the container.

sections.caption: s receives ownership of the String.

sections.text: Matching on a reference `&opt` triggers match ergonomics. Rust automatically binds matched fields as shared references.

sections.caption: s is bound as &String automatically.

sections.text: You do not need to write `ref s` manually. Match ergonomics works through references to keep data borrowed.

explanation: Match on references without moving ownership of non-Copy fields.
